title: Satoshi
full_description: Satoshi is committed to providing the most professional, accurate, and fastest quotation and data analysis services. With globally distributed market data servers, price updates are as fast as ten times per second and allow our users to view massive amounts of global information at the same time. Satoshi provides multi-dimensional analysis and supports price trend analysis, including candlestick charts, OHLC charts, line charts, and professional analysis indicators such as MACD/KDJ/RSI/BOLL/WR. In addition, market capital flow monitoring allows users to view the inflow and outflow of funds in each time period.
